--- title: "Template: how a project post works" description: "A demo post showing code, a chart, an interactive map, and the automatic citation block. Copy this folder to start a new project." date: 2026-10-21 author: Joy Dada draft: true categories: [template, maps] image: thumbnail.png --- This is a **template post**. Every folder in `projects/` with an `index.qmd` shows up on the Projects page. The chart below uses R's built-in `USArrests` data as a stand-in. Swap in your own analysis, such as the NPPES work. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(ggplot2) source(here::here("R/theme_joydada.R")) df <- data.frame(state = rownames(USArrests), USArrests) ``` ::: ## A chart in the site palette ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} top <- head(df[order(-df$UrbanPop), ], 12) p <- ggplot(top, aes(reorder(state, UrbanPop), UrbanPop)) + geom_col(fill = jd_pink[3], width = .7) + coord_flip() + labs(x = NULL, y = "Urban population (%)", title = "Most urban states, 1973") + theme_joydada() ggsave("thumbnail.png", p, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 150, bg = "white") p ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Urban population share, top 12 states (USArrests, 1973).](index_files/figure-html/fig-bar-1.png){#fig-bar width=672} ::: ::: ## An interactive map ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(leaflet) leaflet() |> addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |> setView(-96, 38, zoom = 3) |> addCircleMarkers(lng = -75.16, lat = 39.95, radius = 8, color = jd_pink[3], fillOpacity = .8, label = "Example point") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## Citing this post Because `citation: true` is set in `projects/_metadata.yml`, Quarto adds a **Citation** section with BibTeX at the bottom of every project post. To get a DOI, connect the repo to Zenodo and cut a GitHub release.
